independentReadback.canonicalMaterial: one symbol per line without trailing newline

newAuditQuestion: Does a threshold of 12 distinct consecutive TDCC vintage pairs plus pair-clustered inference by itself establish temporal independence and out-of-sample validity for the frozen IC110 promotion gate?

hypotheses.claim: Distinct consecutive TDCC pairs are statistically independent by construction.
hypotheses.support: A pair is a more appropriate unit than a symbol row; one pair is one episode and avoids cross-sectional pseudo-replication.
hypotheses.counterEvidence: Adjacent pairs (V0,V1) and (V1,V2) share vintage V1. If independent vintage-level measurement noise e_t has variance sigma^2, adjacent differences d_t=e_t-e_(t-1) have variance 2*sigma^2 and covariance Cov(d_t,d_(t+1))=-sigma^2, hence correlation -1/2 in this illustrative null model.
hypotheses.alternative: True concentration persistence, event-driven changes, overlapping symbols, market-wide common shocks and release-calendar timing can change the sign and magnitude; -1/2 is NOT an empirical estimate of actual TDCC pair statistics.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Treat 12 distinct pairs as 12 observational episodes but do not claim iid independence without pair-statistic serial-dependence audit.

hypotheses.claim: Five-session forward outcome labels cannot overlap because TDCC vintages are weekly.
hypotheses.support: Under a stable five-trading-session cadence with timely releases, consecutive executable entry dates can be five sessions apart.
hypotheses.counterEvidence: FirstKnownAt and publication/revision clocks can shift; holidays, delayed releases or out-of-cycle versions can place executable opens fewer than five valid sessions apart.
hypotheses.alternative: If actual executable-open spacing is >=5 sessions, the primary 5-session labels may not overlap; this must be checked using actual intervals rather than presumed.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Compare actual [executableOpen, fifthSubsequentClose] intervals for every pair; intersecting intervals cannot cross training/validation split.

hypotheses.claim: A pair-level partial coefficient plus pooled rank-IC improvement automatically constitutes OOS evidence.
hypotheses.support: Frozen M0 controls and pair-level summaries reduce simple factor redundancy.
hypotheses.counterEvidence: If M0 coefficients or partial residualization use the same validation pair's outcomes, an in-sample association can masquerade as OOS incremental predictiveness. IC110 names both partial coefficient and rank-IC but does not specify a unique promotion primary estimator or exact training/update procedure.
hypotheses.alternative: A genuinely prior-fitted chronological model with purged labels and frozen transforms can generate valid OOS predictions; no such producer/readback has yet been verified.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Until independent D16 method review freezes exact estimator/training windows/regularization and validates chronological predictions, report OOS readiness UNKNOWN, not PASS.

hypotheses.claim: Leave-one-pair-out sign stability and ordinary 95% pair-level confidence interval fully control serial dependence.
hypotheses.support: Pair aggregation and leave-one-out are stronger than pooling thousands of symbol rows.
hypotheses.counterEvidence: Leave-one-out sign stability can remain high when all pairs share persistent shocks; a naive standard error based on 12 iid pair effects can be anti-conservative under positive dependence.
hypotheses.alternative: Serial-dependence-robust inference (e.g., predeclared lag sensitivity or block methods) can be a robustness diagnostic, but 12 episodes may be too few for reliable long-run variance estimation.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Do not replace frozen IC110 inferential gate post hoc. Flag disagreement or unidentifiable dependence as UNKNOWN and route protocol amendment to D16/00 before outcome opening or promotion.

hypotheses.claim: Adding D06 institutional, leverage and passive controls creates independent positive votes.
hypotheses.support: These controls may absorb genuine alternative explanations.
hypotheses.counterEvidence: D06-03 dealer splits, D06-07/08 margin, D06-09 actual shorting, D06-11 passive flows and D06-16 modeled basket exposure may share primitives, and PCF modeled exposure is not executed component stock flow.
hypotheses.alternative: Use M0 primary and M1/M2 only as preregistered robustness with exact primitive lineage; controls with missing PIT timestamps remain UNKNOWN.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Any duplicate primitive identity, mismatched security type, unknown firstKnownAt or inferred actual AP execution blocks independent evidence claims.

deterministicAlgebraCheck.assumptions: iid zero-mean vintage measurement errors e_t, each with variance sigma^2; this is a mathematical toy, NOT actual market data or historical Shadow
deterministicAlgebraCheck.interpretation: A distinct-pair count does not prove independent noise; no claim that actual pair-level rank-IC has -0.5 autocorrelation.
